scope: Original authored art changes only. Exact native geometry/contact regression and the final 12-variant visual review are delegated to the root final batch. No completed-realism claim.

feature_candidate.status: Historical intermediate; retained without overwriting after the side-eye defect was observed.
observations: Thumb/palm opening and native indexed thenar web remove the visibly cut-off rod-like thumb root in actual front/back/oblique hand images.
Female fixed shoulder straps are replaced by a strapless opaque garment clipped from the actual anatomical torso.
Raised eye/orbit/lid/brow region and larger brown iris improve the front-view feature balance.
Male and female side views exposed an existing absolute-Z eyelid/eye plate protruding off the curved face. This intermediate was not accepted.
All eye rim/sclera/iris/pupil/lid points follow face_z at each actual x/y.
The visible floating outer canthus/eye plate is absent in the actual side view.
Eye height stays 1.572m and the source opening remains 9.7mm; the eye region rise is an authored game-art proportion choice, not a medical measurement.
Pupil lift is 2.8mm, catchlight lift2.95mm; mouth/nose, skeleton/rest, physical capsule and distal hand contacts are preserved.

final_assets.full_variant_visual_and_animated_accepta: Pending root final batch; the single-model two-view result alone does not establish all variants and combat poses.

remaining_art_limitations: Neutral simplified expression and facial landmarks remain stylized.
Opaque shaped hair and imperfect strand-flow UV detail remain.
Finger/toe tips, nails and some joint anatomy remain coarse at close range.
No claim of lifelike/AAA/photorealistic character completion.
